description: A series of mysterious thefts have plagued the coastal towns of the Mediterranean. As the sun sets, shadows lengthen, and the truth hides in plain sight. Your task is to unravel the threads of deception woven by a cunning thief who has left behind a trail of misdirection. Each clue whispers secrets, but only the keenest observer will discern the truth.

Witness accounts consistently describe a female figure with black hair.
Lucia's motive aligns with the theft of her own artwork.
Clues about the ocean and artistic references point towards her background.

solution: Connect the clues about the red scarf and the artist's last painting to identify Lucia as the thief.
